_about: The palace's philosophical lenses, as Palace Quotes reaches for them. Each is a palace page (the lens must resolve to an entry), its tradition's voices (whose words a quote may carry), the question it asks of a page, and the families of pages it tends to bite on. Seeded from [[Philosopher Visits the Entry]] § A Starting Roster and [[Palace Philosophies]]. A roster, not a law — place.mjs validates a lens by whether the page exists, not by this file.

lenses.question: What is this page striving to persist as, and does the striving increase its power to act?
lenses.fake: Every page 'has a conatus' — if the reading could be said of any page, it is not Spinoza's.

lenses.question: Which part of this is up to the one doing it, and which is weather?
lenses.fake: A Stoic line used as consolation rather than as a sorting of what is in one's power.

lenses.question: Does this sort what it can act on from what it can only meet?
What does this concern look like from an altitude that resizes it?
Is this wisdom, justice, courage or temperance at work — and which one is missing?
Where is the relation that makes this good, and what does repeated practice of it teach the body?
lenses.fake: A Confucian line that praises harmony in general and names no relation.

lenses.question: Where is this forcing what could flow, and what would it be to leave it alone?
What here is being deliberately left alone, and is the leaving-alone the work?
Is this a field of the virtual being actualized, or a set of options being chosen?
lenses.fake: Vocabulary transplant: 'virtual', 'intensity', 'rhizome' sprinkled on a page whose mechanism they do not touch.

lenses.question: Is this a thing or a process — and what does each occasion take up from what came before?
Is this design concretizing — fewer parts, more integration — or just gaining features?
Can this be absorbed into the body schema — does it disappear in use?
Not a lens. The hub has no apparatus of its own, so The Lens's fidelity test cannot run through it.
lenses.note: Plato, Leibniz, Machiavelli, Zen and Taoism are in the register but have no page yet, so they have no glass yet: no quote through those voices until the page exists. Each is an invitation to write the page. The placer warns when a lens resolves to a hub.
